mlm:name: U-BARN
description: U-BARN (Unet-BERT spAtio-temporal Representation eNcoder) is a self-supervised deep learning model for learning spatio-temporal representations from irregularly sampled multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite image time series. It combines a Unet-based spatial-spectral encoder with a transformer-based temporal encoder, and is pretrained using a BERT-inspired masked reconstruction task.
masking_strategy: Random permutation of spectro-spatial embedding values among selected encoded patches within a batch (temporal masking, 60% masking rate)
pretraining: Self-supervised pretraining on large-scale unlabeled Sentinel-2 L2A time series from France, reconstructing masked patches from annual time series (up to 100 dates) using a shallow decoder and mean squared error loss.
backbone_modifications: Temporal attention at full spatial resolution
Removal of temporal attention from Unet bottleneck
temporal_resolution: 5-day revisit (variable, up to 100 dates per year)
mlm:pretrained_source: Large-scale unlabeled Sentinel-2 L2A dataset (13 tiles over France, 2016-2020)
sampling: Random selection of 10 regions of interest (1024x1024) per tile per year; temporal padding if <100 dates
processing:lineage: Bicubic interpolation for resampling; Robust normalization (quantile clipping, median centering, scaling)
cloud_cover: Cloudy images included; cloud mask used for loss masking only
missing_data: Invalid pixels masked in loss; temporal padding for short series

benchmarks.split_ratio: 5-fold cross-validation (3 train, 1 val, 1 test); samples used: 2433 of 2433 (100%)
60% train, 16% val, 24% test; samples used: 8115 of 8115 (100%)
